author: thestreet.com
title: VIDEO: 5 Business Stories You Must See Friday
text:
Here's everything you need to know before Friday's opening bell: 
Amazon ( AMZN ) said it will focus on capital investments in the grocery and food sector in 2018. Apple ( AAPL ) sold 77.3 million iPhones in its first quarter, below estimates of 80.2 million. Google's ( GOOGL ) paid clicks grew 43%, though the average cost per click declined 14%. Kenichiro Yoshida was named the new CEO and President of Sony ( SNE ) . Stock futures fell sharply as investors eyed government bond yields and a weakening dollar.
